operations.content: Kids Learn project at /Users/dmitrypotekhin/projects/kids-learn/. Web app for kids' math & Python learning, inspired by Brilliant.org. Stack: FastAPI backend (port 8000), React+Vite frontend (port 5173), SQLite, DeepSeek API (deepseek-v4-flash) for explanations. Code sandbox via subprocess (no Docker). Start: ./start.sh or uvicorn backend.main:app --port 8000 (from PROJECT ROOT — NOT from backend/ dir, causes ModuleNotFoundError). Frontend needs Node 20 via nvm.
DeepSeek API key expected in DEEPSEEK_API_KEY env var, loaded from .env file in project root. Base URL: https://api.deepseek.com, model: deepseek-v4-flash. Compatible with OpenAI SDK.
